name: Alarm-source restoration used the wrong end timestamp
remark: Changed alarm restoration from Resolved At to Cleared Alarm Received At, with nonnegative timestamp validation; manual/NOC remains Created At to Closed At.

name: Restoration cause/recovery could use misleading source fields
remark: Root Cause now reads Actual Root Cause only; Action Recovery reads Resolution only. Suspected cause and initial notes are not recovery-field fallbacks.

name: VM Telegram test script path no longer existed
remark: Updated shipped launchers to the retained scripts entry point; verified dry-run startup without a live send.

name: Multiple filter dropdowns stayed open or ignored outside clicks
remark: Shared single-open handling, outside click/Escape close and contained dropdown scrolling verified.

name: Root-cause percentages unreadable in light mode
remark: Adjusted text/legend contrast; tooltip borders and theme visibility corrected.

name: Mentor import feedback and site-code input styling were inconsistent
remark: Immediate validation, progress/completion/failure state, readable font, compact cards and consistent border styling added.

name: Congestion exclusion hid an entire device instead of one interface
remark: Rule identity narrowed to owner + device + interface; other ports and other alarm types remain visible. Legacy portless rules are inactive.

name: Congestion exclusion dialog fields/buttons overlapped
remark: Adjusted dialog heading, subtitle, remark field, footer spacing and small-screen layout.

name: Blacklist popup could show stale responses after another request
remark: Abort previous fetch, ignore stale results and cancel pending request when the modal closes.

name: Resolved WO badge could imply all sibling WOs finished
remark: Added separate strict All WO is Resolved incident result, preserving distinction from individual resolved-WO status badges.

name: Source all-WO flag disagrees with actual sibling WO statuses
remark: Read-only comparison found true flags while a linked WO remained In Progress. Dashboard checks actual siblings; upstream source-flag reconciliation remains outstanding.

name: Missing site codes displayed question marks
remark: Presentation filter uses underscore for blank/question-only values while preserving valid leading-zero and alphanumeric codes.

name: Active Customer Complaint records included unwanted parent statuses
remark: Applicable active queries now require In Progress for that category only. Other categories and historical reports keep their own scopes.

name: SLA root-cause view included met/ungraded records in the old total
remark: Changed to independent Response Not Met and Resolution Not Met counts, with matching drilldowns and exports; shared failures correctly appear in both.

name: Response/Resolution cutoff did not match Cambodia reporting weeks
remark: Aligned weekly cutoffs and detail cohorts with the relevant Cambodia-time date rules.

name: Circuit rename silently reassigned dependent outage data
remark: Stable circuit identity retains associations through rename/blank edits; deleting a circuit affects its related rows rather than selecting another.

name: Deleting report rows did not trigger unsaved-change protection
remark: Structural row insert/delete and user-selection events now mark the document dirty.

name: Weekday popup treated HTTP failures as successfully loaded content
remark: Response status validated; failure shown as retryable and successful content alone becomes cached.

name: Source-provided root-cause text was inserted as HTML
remark: Use escaped/safe text insertion for labels and notes.

name: Required browser security headers absent
remark: Added nosniff, framing protection and a scoped CSP without adding a login requirement.

name: Badge-count processing repeatedly loaded full alarm payloads
remark: Projected the needed columns and measured a local reduction with identical results. VM load testing remains separate.

name: Help redesign removed descriptions/PDF links from the visible page
remark: Restored original articles/introduction and PDF downloads, then added detailed pages without deleting the original documents.

name: Help page left unused screen width
remark: Corrected inherited flex layout and verified full-width/responsive behavior.

name: Help color swatches invisible and unknown POP legend incorrect
remark: Restored swatch dimensions; corrected unknown/blank/unrecognized POP owner to grey and distinguished site-status grey.

name: Help inline labels used smaller text than the surrounding content
remark: Inline labels inherit Huawei Sans and surrounding size; subtle highlight used instead of a different font.

name: Help topic cards had unequal heights and repeated directories
remark: Replaced repeated lists with grouped topic cards, equal desktop heights and working category links/search.

name: PDF-only examples and feature instructions were absent from Help
remark: Added shared worked tables, glossary/checklist, eight feature guides and nine screenshot demonstrations. Split detailed and feature PDFs.

name: POP/PON alarms missing required POP inventory linkage
remark: The POP query excludes missing name/code joins. Source device/POP inventory reconciliation has not been completed; this is not fixed by changing a badge alone.

name: Teams webhook accepted requests without downstream delivery confirmation
remark: HTTP success is not proof the Teams message/SharePoint steps finished. Completion callback or verified Power Automate run history remains required.

name: Frame 9 design remained unfinished after tool quota blocked completion
remark: Frame 8 design delivered; Frame 9 full editable import/completion is still outstanding. Local SVG/PNG fallback exists.

name: Latest Help and PDF changes are not in the Nov-10 V51 ZIP
remark: Existing V51 is verified for its build date only. A newer deployment ZIP containing later Help/PDF work has not been requested/built.
